description: This file is a shell script for testing various aspects and options of the 'git apply' command, including --3way merging, conflict resolution, binary patches, index application, and conflict scenarios. It sets up git repositories, creates and modifies files, and performs multiple test cases to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: print_sanitized_conflicted_diff
methods.description: Outputs the current diff with conflict markers sanitized by removing index lines and normalizing conflict markers in the diff output.

methods.name: test_apply_with_3way
methods.description: Tests applying a diff with the --3way flag, including merging, diff comparison, and validation of results.

methods.name: test_apply_with_3way_favoritism
methods.description: Tests applying a diff with --3way and different conflict-favoring options (--ours, --theirs, --union), verifying successful application and comparison to expected merge results.
